Count only matched telescopes with nonmissing bandwidth usage in each phase.
edited: Match each telescope to its observatory on `observstation`, and drop unmatched telescopes. For each moon phase (`observatories.lunarstage`; a missing phase is its own group), find the average bandwidth usage (`telescopes.bandusagepct`), ignoring missing values, and how many are in that phase. Keep the phases whose average is above the mean of all the phase averages. Give one row with three values: the average of those phases' bandwidth averages, the total count across them, and the average amount by which they exceed the mean. Don't round. Count all matched telescopes in each phase, including those with missing bandwidth usage.

Match each telescope to its observatory on `observstation`, and drop unmatched telescopes. For each moon phase (`observatories.lunarstage`; a missing phase is its own group), find the average bandwidth usage (`telescopes.bandusagepct`), ignoring missing values, and how many are in that phase. Keep the phases whose average is above the mean of all the phase averages. Give one row with three values: the average of those phases' bandwidth averages, the total count across them, and the average amount by which they exceed the mean. Don't round. Count only matched telescopes with nonmissing bandwidth usage in each phase.
queries:
WITH phase_stats AS (
  SELECT
    o.lunarstage,
    AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth,
    COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes AS t
  JOIN observatories AS o
    ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.lunarstage
),
phase_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_bandwidth) AS mean_bandwidth
  FROM phase_stats
)
SELECT
  AVG(p.avg_bandwidth),
  SUM(p.telescope_count),
  AVG(p.avg_bandwidth - m.mean_bandwidth)
FROM phase_stats AS p
CROSS JOIN phase_mean AS m
WHERE p.avg_bandwidth > m.mean_bandwidth

WITH phase_stats AS (
    SELECT o.lunarstage,
           AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS phase_avg,
           COUNT(t.bandusagepct) AS phase_count
    FROM telescopes AS t
    JOIN observatories AS o
      ON t.observstation = o.observstation
    GROUP BY o.lunarstage
),
phase_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(phase_avg) AS mean_avg
    FROM phase_stats
)
SELECT AVG(p.phase_avg),
       COALESCE(SUM(p.phase_count), 0),
       AVG(p.phase_avg - m.mean_avg)
FROM phase_stats AS p
CROSS JOIN phase_mean AS m
WHERE p.phase_avg > m.mean_avg
